paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: if you are in Christ Jesus, there is now no condemnation for you (Romans 8:1). The law couldn't fix us, because it was weakened by the flesh, so God did what it was powerless to do. He sent His own Son as an offering for sin (Romans 8:3). That is why you can stop living like a baker waiting for the boss to walk in and say your cookies are ruined.

Now look at the two minds Paul sets side by side. The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace (Romans 8:6). And you are not controlled by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you (Romans 8:9). So you don't owe the flesh a THING (Romans 8:12), and by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body and you will live (Romans 8:13).

And here's the part that gets me every time. You did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but the Spirit of adoption, and by Him we cry, "Abba! Father!" (Romans 8:15). The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God's children, and children are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ (Romans 8:16-17). Paul is honest that we suffer with Him so that we may also be glorified with Him, but nobody walks that road as a stranger. You belong to the family, friend, so walk in like it.
